title: Turkey & Spinach Meatballs
description: Oven-baked turkey meatballs with spinach, Parmesan and marinara over spaghetti.
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet.
Mix turkey, spinach, breadcrumbs, egg, Parmesan, seasoning and salt just until combined, then shape into about 16 meatballs.
Bake 15–18 minutes, until the meatballs reach 165°F (74°C) internally.
While they bake, cook pasta according to package directions and gently heat marinara.
Toss meatballs in sauce and serve over spaghetti.
